about.hero_quote: "SOURCE was born out of a recognition that 's scientific potential — vast, distributed, and underserved by legacy systems — needed a platform equal to its ambition."
about.hero_desc: Established under the mandate of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, SOURCE — the System for Organizational University, Research & Classification Excellence — national infrastructure for managing, classifying, and elevating academic research output.
about.mission_title: To unify, elevate, and make visible 's scientific research output.
about.mission_desc: SOURCE exists to give every researcher, institution, and journal in  the infrastructure they need to produce, manage, and share scholarly work at the highest international standards. We are the connective tissue between 's universities and the global scientific community.
about.vision_title: as a recognized contributor to global scientific knowledge.
about.vision_desc: We envision an  where academic research is systematically captured, properly classified, and internationally discoverable — where the work of  scholars is visible on the world stage and where the quality of institutional output is measurable, comparable, and continuously improving.
about.story_desc: Before SOURCE, 's universities managed research outputs through disconnected, institution-specific systems — creating duplication, gaps in the national record, and an inability to measure or benchmark academic performance at the ministerial level.
about.milestone1_desc: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research formally establishes the need for a unified national research management system across all  universities.
about.milestone2_desc: A cross-institutional working group comprising university representatives, ministry officials, and technical experts begins the architecture and requirements phase.
about.milestone3_desc: SOURCE enters a controlled pilot phase founding universities across Baghdad — validating the classification framework and submission workflows.
about.milestone4_desc: The platform is extended to all public universities in , with training programmes and dedicated institutional support teams deployed nationwide.
about.values_desc: The principles that guide how we build, operate, and evolve the SOURCE platform — for the long-term benefit of  higher education.
about.value1_desc: Every process within SOURCE is designed to uphold the highest standards of scholarly work — from submission to peer review to publication.
about.value2_desc: Full audit trails, open decision logs, and ministerial oversight at every level ensure that the platform operates with complete institutional accountability.
about.value3_desc: SOURCE is built by and for  institutions — reflecting the realities, languages, and administrative structures of 's higher education landscape.
about.value4_desc: The platform evolves in response to user feedback, international best practices, and the changing needs of 's growing research ecosystem.
about.value5_desc: Connecting researchers, institutions, journals, and the ministry into one unified network — removing silos and enabling the cross-institutional collaboration that advances science.
about.value6_desc: All classification and indexing processes follow international academic standards

home.hero_title_line1: The National Platform for Academic Research
home.about_title: Transforming how  manages its scientific research.
home.about_desc: SOURCE is 's strategic, sovereign digital platform designed to unify and elevate research quality, institutional performance, and national research intelligence within the higher education ecosystem. Operating as a national integration layer connecting researchers, universities, and the Ministry, the platform streamlines the entire academic lifecycle — from methodological conception and governed AI-assisted expert review to publication and ranking indicator monitoring.
home.tile1_desc: National-scale infrastructure for academic research management.
home.tile2_desc: Standards-compliant indexing across all academic fields.
home.tile3_desc: Full audit trail and ministerial oversight of all research activity.
home.tile4_desc: Connected to all 47+  higher education institutions.
home.how_desc: SOURCE is designed for ease of adoption across institutions of all sizes — from large public universities to specialized research centres. The onboarding process is structured and supported at every stage.
home.step1_desc: Universities register through the ministry portal. Administrators receive credentials and configure their institutional profile and departmental structure.
home.step2_desc: Academic staff create certified researcher profiles linked to their institution. Prior publications and academic records are imported and validated.
home.step3_desc: Researchers submit papers, theses, and journal contributions directly through the platform. Submissions are automatically classified and queued for review.
home.step4_desc: Editorial teams manage peer review workflows within the system. Approved research is published in the national index and made discoverable across the network.

audience.hero_desc: SOURCE serves four distinct groups within 's higher education ecosystem — each with tailored tools, workflows, and dashboards designed around their specific responsibilities and goals.
audience.a1_desc: Individual researchers across all  universities use SOURCE to register their publications, build verified academic profiles, and connect their work to the national research index.
audience.a1_p1: Verified researcher profile linked to your institution
audience.a1_p2: Automatic indexing of publications to national record
audience.a1_p4: Submission portal for papers, theses, and conference proceedings
audience.a1_p5: Discovery by ministry reviewers and funding committees
audience.a1_p6: Integration with ORCID and international researcher IDs
audience.a2_desc: Institutions across  use SOURCE to manage their entire research output — from departmental submissions to ministerial reporting — through a single administrative portal.
audience.a2_p1: Institutional dashboard with full research output visibility
audience.a2_p3: Automated ministry compliance and accreditation reporting
audience.a2_p4: Faculty research activity tracking and benchmarking
audience.a2_p5: Role-based access for administrators, deans, and heads of department
audience.a2_p6: Annual research output certificates for accreditation submissions
audience.a3_desc: Scientific journals published by  universities and research centres use SOURCE to manage the full editorial cycle — from manuscript submission through peer review to publication and archiving.
audience.a3_p1: End-to-end manuscript submission and tracking system
audience.a3_p2: Peer review workflow management for editors and reviewers
audience.a3_p3: Editorial decision tools with audit trail
audience.a3_p5: Journal performance analytics and indexing status
audience.a4_desc: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research uses SOURCE as its primary tool for national oversight — monitoring research output, evaluating institutional performance, and informing policy decisions.
audience.a4_p1: National research output dashboard in real time
audience.a4_p4: Research investment and grant allocation tracking
audience.a4_p5: Export-ready ministerial reports for government submissions
